payload.blocks: Only phase 11 and the plan's done: the live grant probe from Miu and the supervisor (acceptance 1), the green-suite gate (acceptance 5) and the folded-rows check. Every other phase is done and landed; nothing else waits on this plan.
payload.headline: Heads-stable phase 11 needs three host steps: activate main, run the full suite, remove two worktrees

parts.cause: All three need an unconfined hand. In this lead's sandbox, npm test cannot start (read-only full-suite lock and cargo target) and fgos worktree remove fails before its checks ('setting aside .agents/skills/ak-advise/SKILL.md: Read-only file system'). Activating a release is the owner's step.

options.cost: About 15-20 minutes of host time for the suite, plus the activation.
options.does: Build, stage and activate main at or after 0174ac6dd; run npm test and cargo test --workspace on it; remove the two worktrees (p13 is dirty: discard its edit, the work landed as 5ebc25616).
options.gain: Phase 11 can finish in one pass: the supervisor and Miu run the probe after their next rotation, the lead writes the report and closes the plan.
options.harm: Activation restarts nothing, but live heads keep their launch grant until they rotate.
options.label: Do all three now

options.cost: The same suite time; one more round later.
options.does: Run the suite and remove the worktrees; activate later.
options.harm: The live probe and the phase 13 write stay unproven until a later activation; the plan stays running.
options.label: Suite and worktrees only

parts.recommendation: Do all three now: one return covers every step this plan still needs from you.

scope.allows: Activating a release built from main, running the two suites, and removing exactly those two worktrees.
scope.forbids: Any change to code or to other plans' worktrees; this lead fixes a red that a phase of this plan caused, through a plan note.

parts.what: Phases 1-10, 12 and 13 are landed on main (tip 0174ac6dd). Phase 11 still needs: (1) a release that carries 5ebc25616 activated, so heads started on it can run the live probe and session write plans/backlog.md works; (2) npm test and cargo test --workspace on main; (3) removal of the clean-or-abandoned worktrees forgent-worktrees/261122-0118-heads-stable-and-able-p13 (abandoned unit edit) and -p11c (empty).
